name: Multi-View Point Splatting
definition: A method for rendering N views simultaneously in a single rendering pass by exploiting GPU programmability to calculate views on a per-fragment basis, solving the linear time complexity ($N 	imes t$) of standard multi-pass approaches.
summary: Multi-View Point Splatting is a single-pass rendering algorithm for auto-stereoscopic displays that interleaves multiple perspective views into one image by calculating per-fragment intersections, avoiding the performance and memory overhead of standard multi-pass methods.
